Alt Text: Quiz card. EAFIT or UdeA: which university site scored higher? Two Medellín universities, EAFIT and the Universidad de Antioquia, 20 public pages each, analyzed by the same review on the same day in October 2026. Scores hidden until tomorrow.

Comparison card. EAFIT 75, UdeA 53. Security is the widest gap. EAFIT leads security, 77 to 16, SEO, 72 to 34, and GEO, 86 to 56. UdeA answers with speed, 68 to 58, and accessibility, 78 to 76. Analytics is close, 85 to 82.

Quiz card. El País or Le Monde: which newspaper site scored higher? Two daily newspapers, from Spain and France, 20 public pages each, analyzed by the same review on the same day in October 2026. Two points separate them. Scores hidden until tomorrow.

Comparison card. El País 74, Le Monde 72. Each wins three areas. El País leads SEO, 73 to 54, accessibility, 94 to 79, and speed, 92 to 83. Le Monde answers with analytics, 97 to 85, security, 62 to 46, and GEO, 61 to 59.
